text.p: Gateway 2000 Inc, a direct marketer of personal computers, said Wednesday it was launching a range of desktop systems powered by Intel Corp's new Pentium II microprocessor.
Gateway said it is offering systems with both 233 megahertz and 266 megahertz Pentium II processors in a number of different configurations, with pricepoints starting at $2,499.

Earlier today, Intel introduced the Pentium II microprocessor family, a line that includes advanced multimedia capabilities and faster computing speeds. Intel said that more than 100 computer makers will introduce personal computers designed around the Pentium II.

"We anticipate the Pentium II processor will quickly emerge as the processor of choice for a large percentage of our customers," Ted Waitt, Gateway chairman, said in a statement. "In the first few hours, Gateway has already sold over a thousand Pentium II systems worldwide."
